## 2. Genomic-to-c. mapper

Derived from gnomAD canonical SNVs (exon offsets by majority vote; vote purity per exon: 1.00, 1.00, 1.00, 1.00, 1.00, 1.00, 1.00). Reproduces 713/713 gnomAD SNV names. Caveat: offsets are fitted on the same rows, so this checks internal consistency (intron nearest-rule, strand handling, UTR numbering), not an independent reference. Re-check against NM_000169 FASTA when supplied.

## 2b. Reference checks (NM_000169.3 GenBank)

SNVs with a reference-base check possible (CDS, c.-22..-1, c.*1..*6): 2440; **mismatching: 0**. CDS translation equals the GenBank translation (429 aa); exon ends from the record (c.194/369/547/639/801/999) equal the boundaries used for IVS conversion.
